append.detail: 2026-11-03: Services' own sixteen trade kits are built (General plus fifteen trades: home, wellness, pro, trades, cleaning, beauty, fitness, pets, tutoring, creative, legal, medical, events, auto, landscaping): lib/sites/kits/services-trades-data.ts (the design's words), services-variants.ts (pages), services-profile-index.ts (library rows), loaders `services-<trade>` in the registry. All sixteen share the General niche id, so no Mega niche or pinned test changed; the trade is the kit's own id. Sample prices ride slot tokens, trust lines with numbers became prompts, reviews are prompts.
